post.caption:
Methuselah, a bristlecone pine in California, is around 4,850 years old and its location is kept secret. Then there is Pando in Utah: 47,000 genetically identical aspen stems sharing one root system, estimated at tens of thousands of years. The oldest tree depends entirely on where you decide one tree ends.
